title: check-half-states blockedByTargets: a "Blocked-by: none. …" line that names a card later in the sentence is read as blocked by that card, so card-pick hides a p1
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxRDKprCtjpEdtiPFW

Filing gate: ① an instrument defect with a named location and a measured instance. Source: seat repo:objectstack#1 area `o1-F`, W0 survey 2026-11-28.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：取卡工具把「Blocked-by: none. 与 #36987 的裁决无关」这一行读成「被 #36987 挡住」，于是把一张 p1 卡从可取清单里藏掉了。
- 谁受益：所有用 `card-pick.mjs` 取卡的席位，和读半态巡查的分诊席。
- 不做会怎样：写了「无阻塞」并顺带提到别的卡的卡片，会一直被当成阻塞卡，没人去取。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Reading

- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:3994` `blockedByTargets` takes every `#N` in the `Blocked-by:` directive value (`BLOCKED_BY_REF` over `directiveValues(body, 'Blocked-by')`). A value that opens with `none` still yields the refs that follow it.
- Instance: #37446 (p1) and #37445 (p2) both carry the line `Blocked-by: none. Order: independent of #36987's ruling.`. `node scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs --order area:fleet --why` on 2026-11-28T01:36Z printed both as `Blocked-by: #36987 (open)` and left them out of the picks. #37446 was found by hand and claimed (7231942694).
- Readers that share the parser: `card-pick.mjs` (via `blockerTargetsFor`), H19 / H26 / H28 and `buildBlockingIndex` in `check-half-states.mjs`.

## Fix

A `Blocked-by:` value whose first token is `none` (any case, before any `#N`) names no target. Pin it with this line verbatim, and keep a value like `#A, #B` and a bulleted or bolded directive reading as before.

## Done when

The self-test pins the `none. … #N` shape as zero targets, and `card-pick.mjs --why` no longer lists #37445 under `Blocked-by: #36987`.

Dedupe: `is:issue "Blocked-by: none" card-pick` (24 hits) and `is:issue blockedByTargets` (13 hits) read by title: none is about a `none` value that names a later card. Nearest closed: #10061, #17564 (comment-channel readings).
Suggested-grade: p2 · a reader that hides queueable cards (a p1 among them) from every seat.
